title: AI for Production Module 1 — fictional finance/payables hook
scope: Finance and audit / accounts-payable spreadsheet transfer case; original recording and assessments remain unchanged.

problemHook.title: The payables rule stays the same. Can you trust the AI explanation?
problemHook.question: What would you check first in the payables sheet before accepting the AI explanation, and what tells you whether the routing rule changed?
problemHook.situation:
Fictional finance and audit case: you review accounts-payable requests in a spreadsheet. A fixed rule routes a request to the same review queue whenever its required fields are complete. The queue has become busier, but the rule has not changed.
A colleague asks an AI assistant why the queue is growing. The assistant confidently blames duplicate supplier requests. The supplied spreadsheet shows queue entries, but contains no duplicate-check result. Its explanation sounds useful; you still need to inspect what supports it.
This is a payables analogy for the supplied production lesson, not a real payment decision. In the original recording, coolant has aged but the cooler still switches on at its programmed 70-degree threshold. That equipment threshold belongs only to the source example. Here you inspect administrative rules and an unsupported explanation; you do not approve payments or change equipment.
